boxes.meaning: script of a play or film

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the written text of a play, film, or other performance.
This is the all-purpose choice for a screenplay when the medium is clear from context.
Use this when referring to the written script or play text itself rather than the dramatic genre.

examples.english: I still haven't read the script for this movie.
examples.traditional: 我仲未睇過呢套戲嘅劇本。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 tai2 gwo3 ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 bun2

examples.traditional: 呢份劇本寫得好有張力。
examples.jyutping: ne1 fan6 kek6 bun2 se2 dak1 hou2 jau5 zoeng1 lik6

examples.english: This drama script is beautifully nuanced.
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 kek6 bun2 se2 dak1 hou2 sai3 nei6

english.note: Use this metaphorically when the scenario is presented as a planned or unfolding script of events.

examples.english: If they really follow this scenario, the whole thing will blow up.
examples.traditional: 如果佢哋真係照呢個劇本行，場戲就會鬧大。
